beverages_details.name: Fuzzy navel
beverages_details.alcohol_description: A fuzzy navel is a mixed drink made from peach schnapps and orange juice. The addition of another 1 or 1½ oz of vodka to the fuzzy navel creates a 'hairy navel', the more 'hair' referring to the increased strength of alcohol in the drink.

beverages_details.name: Pastis
beverages_details.alcohol_description: Pastis is an anise-flavoured spirit and apéritif from France, typically containing from 40–45% ABV (alcohol by volume).

conclusion_reasoning: Both Fuzzy navel (containing peach schnapps and potentially vodka) and Pastis (an anise-flavoured spirit with 40-45% ABV) are described as alcoholic beverages in the context.
